title: Every pane change goes through a pane action: dispatch's door, resume, claim, open, send, release, close, restore
notes: First of the per-noun moves (from 730fb775). Gaps #233 left: pane.dispatch has no door yet, main calls startPane directly (main.ts:572); the drawer's resume (resumeInWorker, main.ts:543, from sessions:resume) and a pane that comes back as a plain shell (resumeIn's shell branch, main.ts:432) still type claude --resume into the shell instead of going through pane.dispatch, so they get no worker hooks and no agent-start log line. Then pane.claim, open (pane:add), send, release, close (pane:close, closeWorker), restore (spawnProject, screensComeBack, adoptSurvivors, resumeIn). The write(resumeLine( count in bypasses.test.ts goes to 0. Plan: docs/actions/inventory.md (actions-decision-4, actions-rule-1). Lower this noun's rows in src/main/actions/bypasses.test.ts to what is left. No new doors around an action.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #235. Every pane change is now a pane action: dispatch (all doors), open, close, send, claim, release, restore. The restart's plain-shell resume and the drawer's resume go through pane.dispatch, so they get hooks, the agent-start log line and the working mark. resumeLine is gone, the write(resumeLine( count is 0, and the pane bypass rows are lowered. Still to check by hand in the rebuilt app: a restart with a Claude of yours in a terminal, and a resume from the drawer.
